answer_1.quote: The evaluation of machine translation (MT) systems aims to quantitatively assess their performance...
answer_1.outputs: MT translation hypotheses (system outputs) evaluated by metrics

answer_2.quote: We employ two meta-evaluation methods: correlation performance and pairwise accuracy. The Pearson correlation ... is used as a common metric used in evaluating system-level performance.

answer_4.quote: We used MQM scores as the reference and evaluate how well the scores produced by metrics correlate with them. Human rating data obtained from the WMT Metrics task is used as the gold standard.
answer_4.guideline: Human experts assign MQM error annotations and severity scores to system outputs; metrics are compared against these human scores.
